description: This file defines an abstract class 'EntityMeta' in PHP, which provides metadata handling for entities within the vtiger CRM web services layer. It includes methods for retrieving entity fields, mapping columns, and checking permissions, serving as a base class for specific entity implementations.

classes.name: EntityMeta
classes.description: An abstract class providing metadata operations for CRM entities, including field information, access control, and entity properties.

methods.name: getEmailFields
methods.description: Returns a list of email-type fields for the entity.

methods.name: getFieldColumnMapping
methods.description: Provides a mapping from field names to database column names.

methods.name: getMandatoryFields
methods.description: Returns a list of mandatory fields for the entity.

methods.name: getReferenceFieldDetails
methods.description: Returns details of reference-type fields.

methods.name: getOwnerFields
methods.description: Lists owner-type fields.

methods.name: getObectIndexColumn
methods.description: Returns the primary key column for the entity.

methods.name: getUserAccessibleColumns
methods.description: Lists columns accessible to the user.

methods.name: getFieldByColumnName
methods.description: Retrieves field details given a column name.

methods.name: getColumnTableMapping
methods.description: Provides a mapping from columns to their respective database tables.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Returns the user object associated with the entity.

methods.name: hasMandatoryFields
methods.description: Checks if the provided data row has all mandatory fields populated.

methods.name: isUpdateMandatoryFields
methods.description: Checks if the updated fields include all mandatory fields.

methods.name: getModuleFields
methods.description: Returns the module fields metadata.

methods.name: getFieldNameListByType
methods.description: Lists field names by their data type.

methods.name: getFieldListByType
methods.description: Lists field objects by their data type.

methods.name: getIdColumn
methods.description: Returns the name of the ID column.

methods.name: getEntityBaseTable
methods.description: Returns the base table name for the entity.

methods.name: getEntityTableIndexList
methods.description: Returns index list of the entity table.

methods.name: getEntityDefaultTableList
methods.description: Returns default table list for the entity.

methods.name: getEntityTableList
methods.description: Returns all related tables for the entity.

methods.name: getEntityAccessControlQuery
methods.description: Provides the access control SQL query segment for the entity.

methods.name: getEntityDeletedQuery
methods.description: Provides the SQL condition for non-deleted records.

methods.name: hasPermission
methods.description: Abstract method to check if a certain operation is permitted.

methods.name: hasAssignPrivilege
methods.description: Abstract method to check assign privilege.

methods.name: hasDeleteAccess
methods.description: Abstract method to verify delete permissions.

methods.name: hasAccess
methods.description: Abstract method to verify general access.

methods.name: hasReadAccess
methods.description: Abstract method to verify read access.

methods.name: hasWriteAccess
methods.description: Abstract method to verify write permissions.

methods.name: getEntityName
methods.description: Abstract method to get the entity's name.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Abstract method to get the entity's ID.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Abstract method to check if a record exists.

methods.name: getObjectEntityName
methods.description: Abstract method to get object entity name by ID.

methods.name: getNameFields
methods.description: Abstract method to get name fields.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Abstract method to get record name by webservice ID.

methods.name: isModuleEntity
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if entity is a module entity.
